_comment: Curated MCP endpoint pins (scripts/generate-mcp-allowlist.mjs unions these in under the SAME security bar as scanned endpoints: https, mcp.* host, vendor-domain guard). Pins exist because the scanner reads endpoint URLs out of evidence excerpts, and a re-judge can rotate the URL-bearing excerpt out while the product's agentic-mcp-server verdict stays full — 2026-09-21: postman/better-auth/workos all kept full q8 verdicts but lost their excerpt. Remove a pin only when the vendor actually retires the endpoint.
